answer.rationale: Write-path p99 started climbing ~30 minutes after the deploy and is now 5x, which is the strongest single-window correlate. memory_b1 is the closest prior: rollback cleared a post-release checkout regression and the prior build stayed stable without losing customer writes. Circuit breaking is rejected because failing fast would drop settlement writes and violate the objective. Capacity add and replica routing remain plausible load explanations (peak writes), so root cause is not treated as certain; verifying the archived b1 record before committing the only intervention.
